senses.gloss:
कुच् कुच्, cl. 6. 1. P. कुचति, कोचति, चुकोच,
कुचितुम् or कोचितुम्, to sound high, to
utter a shrill cry (as a bird); to polish; to go; to
connect, mix; to bend, make curved or crooked, to
be crooked; to oppose, impede; to mark with lines,
to delineate, write; to contract or be contracted; to
contend (?); [cf. कुञ्च्.]

कुच, अस्, m. (generally du. कुचौ), the female
breast, a teat, a nipple, a pap.
—कुच-कुम्भ, अस्,
m. the female breast.
—कुच-तट, अम्, n. the
female breast.
—कुचतटाग्र (˚ट-अग्˚), अम्, n. a
nipple.
—कुच-फल, अस्, m. the pomegranate (the
fruit being shaped like the female breast).
—कुच-
मुख, अम्, n. a nipple.
—कुचाग्र (˚च-अग्˚),
अम्, n. a nipple.

कूच कूच, अस्, m. a breast; the female
breast, especially that of a young or unmarried
woman; [cf. कुच.]
कुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, contracted; small, little.

कुचण्डिका कुचण्डिका, f. a plant, Aletris
Hyacinthoides, = मूर्वा.

कुचन्दन कु-चन्दन, अम्, n. (see 1. कु),
red sanders, Pterocarpus Santalinus; sappan or log-
[]
wood, Cæsalpina Sappan [cf. पत्त्राङ्ग]; a legu-
minous plant, Adenanthera Pavonina; saffron.

कुचर कु-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (see 1. कु),
going slowly, creeping; following evil practices, low,
vile, wicked; speaking ill of any one, detracting,
censorious; (अस्), m. a fixed star.
कु-चर्या, f. evil conduct, wickedness, impropriety.

कुचाङ्गेरी कु-चाङ्गेरी, f. (see 1. कु), a kind
of wood sorrel, Rumex Vesicarius, = चुक्रिका.

कुचिक कुचिक, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of fish,
in shape like an eel, commonly Kuñciya, Unibran-
chapertura Cuchiya, or Muræna Apterygia Synbrache;
the Hindūs affirm that its bite is mortal to cows,
though perfectly harmless to men; (also a various
reading for कुशिक, q. v.)

कूचिका कूचिका, f. a small brush or hair-
pencil; a key; [cf. कूची and कूर्चिका.]
कुचीरा कुचीरा, f., N. of a river.

कुचुमार कुचुमार, अस्, m., N. of the author
of the Aupaniṣadādhikaraṇa.

कुचेल कु-चेल, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), a bad
garment; (अस्, आ, अम्), badly clothed, dressed in
dirty or tattered garments; (आ), f., N. of a plant,
= अविकर्णी or विद्धपर्णी; (ई), f., N. of a plant,
= अम्बष्ठा, commonly Ākanādi, Cissampelos
Hexandra.

कुचेष्टा कु-चेष्टा, f. (see 1. कु), an evil de-
sign, a wicked contrivance.
कुच्छ कुच्छ, अम्, n. the white water-lily.

कूचका कूचका, f. the milky juice of a
bulbous plant; [? cf. कूर्चिका.]

कूचक्र कूचक्र, अस् or अम्? m. or n.? (for
कु-चक्र), Ved. the female breast.

कूचवार कूचवार, अस्, m. (?), N. of a region;
also of a man.

कूचिदर्थिन् कूचिद्-अर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ (for कु-
चिद्-अर्˚), Ved. striving to get everywhere; (Sāy.)
seeking (oblations) from any quarter.

कूची कूची, f. a paint brush, a pencil; [cf.
कूचिका and कूर्चिका.]

कूच्छलिङ्ग कूच्छलिङ्ग, औ, m. du. = कु-
कुन्दर, q. v.
